description: The line plot, titled “ChatGPT on Movies,” illustrates the trends in Accuracy (blue circles, solid line), Confidence (green triangles, solid line), and Alignment (red squares, solid line) of ChatGPT as a function of Question Popularity, which ranges from 15 to 55 along the x-axis with linear spacing and no units specified. The y-axis, labeled “Values,” spans from 0.86 to 1.00 in linear increments of 0.02. Accuracy begins at approximately 0.895 at Question Popularity 15, dips slightly to 0.90 at 17.5, then rises steadily to 0.985 at 55. Confidence starts near 0.975 at 15, fluctuates slightly before rising to 0.995 at 30, and remains nearly flat at 0.995 through 55. Alignment begins at 0.92 at 15, dips to 0.915 at 17.5, peaks at 0.975 around 22.5, dips again to 0.97 at 25, and then climbs steadily to 0.99 at 55. All three metrics show an overall upward trend with increasing question popularity, with Confidence maintaining the highest and most stable values across the range.
